verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence pack documents a Logseq feature for viewing a page's version history, restoring earlier versions, or recovering deleted notes; the Logseq Sync docs cover only multi-device syncing and encryption. Users keeping graphs in a git repo is a user-side workaround, and the `logseq.Git` plugin API namespace is a developer building block, so neither earns credit for this story.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can view a note's version history and restore earlier versions or recover deleted notes
